description: Break down spending by category for a date range. Shows each category's total spending and percentage of total.

end_date.description: End date (YYYY-MM-DD or natural language). Defaults to today.

limit.description: Maximum number of categories to show (default 20)

start_date.description: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD or natural language). Defaults to start of current month.

name: spending_by_category
